entries.ae1ed24ac182363d: The core of the strategy is to build on the harbor transportation business, which accounts for 98% of revenue, by selecting and focusing on target shippers and cargo types; to expand orders for international integrated transport through collaboration with the China office and overseas partners; and to consolidate the earnings base by strengthening cost-responsiveness.
entries.b13ac8d74078ee14: Based on its management philosophy, 'Always opening up a rich future for comprehensive logistics,' the company aims to become a business that contributes to society by pursuing 'Creative Logistics.' As its medium- to long-term management strategy, the company aims to establish a corporate structure able to respond to changes in diversifying shippers and markets, and to strengthen its sales capabilities, enhance facilities and equipment from a medium- to long-term perspective, research and develop new transport methods, and train the personnel to carry them out. Priority items are selecting priority target shippers and cargo types; strengthening the sales functions of the China office and expanding overseas partners; strengthening sales capabilities; expanding the partner network with 3PL in view, based on the harbor transportation business; and improving productivity through low-cost operations.
